breakdown.description: The prompt treats the bending moment as constant and equal to P L over the entire span, even though the cantilever moment varies linearly from the free end to the fixed end.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Use constant moment P L for deflection calculation,' directly repeating the incorrect assumption from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth makes no such assumption; the bending moment in a cantilever varies linearly from zero at the free end to PL at the fixed end.
